plugins.description: Seven Claude skills for intraday trading in NSE F&O stocks: a chart scanner, an NSE news and announcements monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner with NSE tick rounding, a time machine, a budget manager that writes Zerodha Kite orders, and a risk manager with a trade log. Nothing places orders.
